title: The Stories of Sherlock Holmes
paragraphs: A South African Springbok Radio series of original Sherlock Holmes adventures, with Graham Armitage as Holmes and Kerry Jordan as Dr. Watson. Exact episode dates remain withheld in this catalog where the surviving references are not firm enough.

South African Springbok Radio Sherlock Holmes series produced by Michael Silver, starring Graham Armitage as Sherlock Holmes and Kerry Jordan as Dr. Watson. Specialist reference describes 47 or 50 episodes and explicitly warns that listed dates are not fully verified. Frozen GRH subset contains 18 archive objects, including one exact duplicate-audio pair under conflicting Crouch End/Kraut End labels.
GRH documents the program through Springbok Radio run (1979 to 1985) on [[org|org.e940cdfed3514f24|Springbok Radio]].
Among the most extensively documented contributors in the GRH holdings are Graham Armitage (performer on 18 recordings) and Kerry Jordan (performer on 18 recordings).

Its indexed subjects and listening characteristics include Sherlockian deduction and criminal investigation, South African Springbok Radio drama, Sherlock Holmes adaptation and pastiche, Victorian/Edwardian British mystery setting, original Holmes radio mystery, and Irene Adler.

GRH also places the series in documented historical contexts including Springbok Radio Sherlock Holmes run, Sherlock Holmes canon and original-radio-story mixture, and Incomplete and uncertain surviving chronology.
